// diagnostic

E0631

`{view}` cannot be shared — it does not live long enough to {escape}.

What

`{view}` cannot be shared — it does not live long enough to {escape}.

Why

`{view}` is a view into `{arena}`; sharing it outside the region would let it outlive `{arena}` and point into freed memory.

Fix

Keep the view inside the arena's region, or copy what you need out with `~` before it leaves.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0631: tests/ui/arena_view_escape.stderr.

Error [E0631]: `x` cannot be shared — it does not live long enough to be returned

    |            ^
 Why: `x` is a view into `arena`; sharing it outside the region would let it outlive `arena` and point into freed memory
 Fix: keep `x` inside the `arena` region, or copy what you need out with `~` before it leaves
